description: List the chains a balance on fromChainId can be swept to, receiving that chain's native gas (e.g. ETH on Base, BNB on BSC, HYPE on HyperEVM). Destinations are not limited to the chains ZeroDust sweeps from: any EVM chain a bridge serves qualifies. Call this before quoting a cross-chain sweep to pick where the funds should go.
name: zerodust_get_destinations
